The petitioner has filed this petition under Section 166 of Motor Vehicle Act, claiming compensation of Rs.40,00,000/- for the accidental injuries sustained by him in a road traffic accident took place on 29.01.2023.
2.

The Brief facts of the petitioner's case is as under:
It is the case of the petitioner that on 29.01.2023 at about 11.30 a.m., petitioner was riding a motorcycle bearing Reg. No. KA- 42-Q-0457 along with his wife Smt.Pramila H.M on Chakkere- Byrapatna road, Chakkere Village, Ramanagara District and  SCCH-21 MVC No.1007/2023 proceeding towards Channapatna, slowly, observing the traffic rules on extreme left side of the road.

When they reached near Chakkere Village, Malluru Hobli, at that time all of a sudden a lorry bearing Reg.No. KA-51-MF-2677 driven by its driver at a very high speed, in a rash and negligent manner without observing traffic norms, endangering to human life and dashed against the petitioner's Motorcycle from opposite direction. Due to the tremendous impact, the petitioner fell down from the motorcycle on the road and sustained grievous injuries to his right thigh and left knee joint.

Immediately, he was shifted to Government Hospital, Channapatna for first aid treatment and then he was shifted to KIMS Hospital, Bangalore, wherein he was treated as inpatient and petitioner has spent more than Rs.3,00,000/- towards medical expenses.
